newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - November 6.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - November 6.

text.p: Turnover in kerb trade through the Warsaw bourse was at 16.1 million zlotys on Wednesday.
The following is a summary of the day's block transactions on the Warsaw bourse.
* 2,000 variable-interest 10-year bonds maturing on July 18, 2006 traded at 70 zlotys.
* 980 variable-interest 10-year bonds maturing on October 18, 2006 traded at 70 zlotys.
* 29,325 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on February 6, 1999 traded at 100.7 zlotys.
* 5,265 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on February 6, 1999 traded at 101.2 zlotys.
* 37,791 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on August 6, 1998 traded at 100.9 zlotys.
* 27,790 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on August 6, 1998 traded at 87.3 zlotys.
* 11,900 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on November 6, 1998 traded at 101 zlotys.
* 29,326 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on November 6, 1998 traded at 100.7 zlotys.
